op.origin: createUnaryOp(cls, rhs, op): op is either a FuncMap key NAME (str) or a callable. Seeded enum domain {Not, USub, <lambda>}.

encoding.notes: isinstance(op, str) is a runtime type test on a live object. Modeled over the seeded enum by partitioning members into str-typed (Not, USub) and the non-str callable (<lambda>). The type predicate is abstracted as set-membership in the str partition; z3 confirms both partitions are non-empty, i.e. both the if-branch (op is a name string) and the else-branch (op is a function) are reachable. z3 cannot itself decide a live object type, hence solver_status=unknown for the underlying predicate.

z3_run.note: z3 4.16.0; both directions sat over the str/non-str partition of the seeded enum.

contracts_checked: post: (__return__ == True) == isinstance(op, str)  over op: Union[str, Callable]
crosshair.caveat: Absence of a counterexample from CrossHair is NOT a proof; here the helper is a tautological wrapper of isinstance, so the contract is trivially satisfied. It confirms the helper faithfully mirrors the branch, nothing stronger.

verification.method: Evaluated isinstance(op, str) in the container python on each witness VALUE.
verification.false_witness_check: isinstance(lambda val:-val, str)=False (the lambda has __name__==<lambda>, callable==True)

classification_rationale: The predicate isinstance(op, str) is a runtime type test on a live object passed to createUnaryOp. The discriminator is the actual Python type of op (str FuncMap-key name vs a function object), which a numeric/boolean SMT solver cannot decide on its own. z3 can only confirm, over the seeded enum partitioned into str vs non-str members, that BOTH branches are reachable (true_check=sat op=Not, false_check=sat op=Lambda). Therefore classification=runtime-dependent and solver_status=unknown, with representative true/false witnesses given by VALUE and confirmed against the real Python runtime so downstream can pin behavior. A reified test would call createUnaryOp with op="Not"/"USub" (str-branch: asserts in FuncMap, name==op) and op=<a lambda> (else-branch: name==CustomUnaryOp).
